timed_events.message: Ashford here. Twenty minutes left. Tell me you have something to show.
Emergency lighting activates. Pip looks at you nervously. The golem hums faster. Five minutes remain.

triggered_events.message: Papers sorted. Marcus skipped Requirements and Design entirely. No wonder the golem built nonsense.
All three specs written. The scroll frame glows. The Golem Workshop door unlocks.
Context loaded. The golem's eyes flicker — it can read the specs now.
MCP conduits connected. The golem can now reach external tools. Build Yard doors open.
First command issued. The golem begins building from the design specs.
Architecture placed. CDK, Lambda, DynamoDB, CloudFront — all in the right layers.
Codebase mapped. The deployment config is found. Launch Tower unlocks.
Playwright test pipeline built. Navigate, login, fill, assert, screenshot.
Deployment sequence correct. Infrastructure first, then frontend with real URLs.
CORS error identified. The API needs Access-Control-Allow-Origin headers.
You press DEPLOY. The URL goes live. Lord Ashford sees a working social platform. Episode complete.
